design_authority: docs/us_short_system_design.md §4.2 (财报实际/基础财务) / §3.1 (provenance) / §3.5 (PIT: 观测/来源/公开日不得晚于决策 as_of; 不用 look-ahead 证据) / §18.2 (跨模块契约先 schema-first 冻结再消费)
authorization_note: OFFLINE contract SHAPE only. Live Massive fetch + runner wiring stay gated under SR-PROVIDER-001. Reachability + real shape were proven 2026-07-01 (docs/us_short_cut5_pass2_feasibility_probe_summary_20260701.json + captured gitignored raw): Massive/Polygon /vX/reference/financials with timeframe=quarterly|annual returns a real filing_date + acceptance_datetime (the 10-Q/10-K public dates) plus income/balance/cash-flow concepts, each {value, unit, label, order}. The ttm DEFAULT returned a NULL filing_date and is excluded. This binding freezes the shape a producer must honor; it selects no provider and authorizes no fetch/DataHub/production/ship-gate.
excluded_timeframe_note: ttm is EXCLUDED: the trailing-twelve-month rollup has a NULL filing_date (no single 10-Q/10-K public date to PIT-anchor it, confirmed by the 2026-07-01 probe). Only quarterly / annual periods carry a real filing_date.
line_item_value_contract: each Massive concept is {value, unit, label, order}; the parser extracts the finite numeric `value` (which MAY be negative — a net loss / negative operating cash flow is legal) and requires a nonempty `unit` string. A missing bound concept is recorded absent (never fabricated / never zero-filled); a present-but-non-finite value (NaN/Inf/bool/string) fails closed.
pit_rule: filing_date (the SEC 10-Q/10-K public date Massive returns for periodic financials) must be a real YYYY-MM-DD <= as_of; a period with a null / missing / future filing_date is EXCLUDED (unknowable PIT / look-ahead, §3.5). period_end (fiscal period end) is NOT a public date and is NEVER used as a PIT anchor.

emission_fitness.note: only a full-coverage clean-parse ticker emits actual-financials records; partial / missing / failed / degraded -> excluded (conservative — the offline slice has no data-quality downgrade channel, so it fails closed rather than emit partial fundamentals).

date_format: as_of / filing_date / period_start / period_end = YYYY-MM-DD (ASCII, real-calendar); acceptance_datetime + observed_at = tz-aware RFC3339 date-time
consumer_note: Produces the §4.2 财报实际/基础财务 FACT layer (per fiscal period, PIT-anchored to the real filing_date). The specific SCORE wiring — an earnings-growth signal, or the 财报实际vs预期 surprise once the estimate half is un-gated (per the 2026-07-01 user decision the analyst-estimate/consensus half stays un-hooked, future-paid-gated) — is a LATER seam. This slice freezes the fact contract + parses/validates it; it does NOT score.

duplicate_policy.note: one report per fiscal period; a repeated (timeframe, fiscal_year, fiscal_period) within a ticker fails closed (never silently deduped or double-counted). An amended/restated period is resolved to the authoritative filing upstream (gated live half), not injected as a duplicate.

checked_empty_note: a full-coverage clean-parse ticker with NO PIT-fit period emits a CHECKED coverage record (disposition checked_no_pit_fit_period) retaining its provenance — DISTINCT from a ticker never queried (§3.3, must not collapse checked to unknown).
